title: Experiment 1 — Separate a Mixture of Iron Filings, Sand and Alum
apparatus: Equipment: China dish, funnel, magnet, watch glass, filter paper, funnel stand, Bunsen burner or spirit lamp, glass rod, beaker, match box, tripod stand · Chemicals: Fe (iron filings), alum, sand and water
description: Employ appropriate physical methods (magnetic separation, dissolution, filtration, and evaporation/crystallisation) to separate a mixture of iron filings, sand and alum.

title: Experiment 2 — Demonstrate Decomposition Reaction of Calcium Carbonate
apparatus: Equipment: Test tubes, mortar pestle, safety goggles, match box, Bunsen burner or spirit lamp, test tube holder, one holed stopper with glass tube and rubber tubing or bent tube · Chemicals: Calcium carbonate and lime water (solution of calcium hydroxide)
description: Demonstrate that compounds can be the products of a decomposition reaction by heating calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) and passing the evolved CO₂ gas through freshly prepared lime water.

title: Experiment 3 — Measure the Boiling Point of Ethyl Alcohol
apparatus: Equipment: Beaker, iron stand, clamp, glass rod, thermometer, fusion tube, tripod stand, capillary tube, wire gauze, matchbox, Bunsen burner or spirit lamp · Chemicals: Sample of ethyl alcohol and water
description: Measure the boiling point of ethyl alcohol using a water bath and capillary/fusion tube assembly.

title: Experiment 4 — Measure the Melting Point of Wax
apparatus: Equipment: Beaker, iron stand, clamp, glass rod, thermometer, capillary tube, tripod stand, wire gauze, match box, Bunsen burner or spirit lamp, thread · Chemicals: Sample of wax and water
description: Measure the melting point of wax using the capillary tube method in a heated water bath.

title: Experiment 5 — Demonstrate Sublimation Using Solid Ammonium Chloride
apparatus: Equipment: Test tube, cotton, test tube holder, match box, Bunsen burner or spirit lamp · Chemicals: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl)
description: Demonstrate sublimation using solid ammonium chloride in a cotton-plugged test tube.

title: Experiment 6 — Prepare 250 cm³ / 1 Litre of 0.1 M Oxalic Acid Solution
apparatus: Equipment: Beaker, glass rod, spatula, balance (physical/digital), funnel, pipette, filter paper/watch glass (for weighing), weight box, volumetric flask (250 cm³ / 1 litre) · Chemicals: Oxalic acid, distilled water
description: Prepare a standard 250 cm³ (or 1 litre) solution of 0.1 M oxalic acid by accurate weighing and dilution to the calibration mark.

title: Experiment 7 — Prepare 100 cm³ of 0.01 M Na₂CO₃ Solution from 0.1 M Solution
apparatus: Equipment: Beaker, volumetric flask, stirrer, graduated cylinder or pipette · Chemicals: Distilled water, 0.1 M Na₂CO₃ solution
description: Prepare 100 cm³ of 0.01 M Na₂CO₃ solution by quantitative dilution (M₁V₁ = M₂V₂) from the given 0.1 M Na₂CO₃ stock solution.

title: Experiment 8 — Demonstrate That Temperature Affects Solubility
apparatus: Equipment: Beaker, glass rod, Bunsen burner or spirit lamp, tripod stand, wire gauze, match box · Chemicals: Sucrose and water
description: Demonstrate the effect of temperature on the solubility of sucrose in water.

title: Experiment 9 — Prepare Crystals of Copper Sulphate
apparatus: Equipment: Beaker, tripod stand, wire gauze, filter paper, china dish, funnel, filter stand, stirrer, match box, Bunsen burner or spirit lamp · Chemicals: Impure copper sulphate and distilled water
description: Prepare pure crystals of copper(II) sulphate pentahydrate (CuSO₄·5H₂O) from an impure sample via dissolution, filtration, concentration, and crystallisation.

title: Experiment 10 — Perform Paper Chromatography to Separate an Ink Mixture
apparatus: Equipment: Whatman filter paper No. 1, glass cylinder with a glass support, rubber bung, capillary tubes, lead pencil · Chemicals: Developing solvents (water–alcohol mixture / n-butanol, ethanol and ammonia) and mixture of inks (blue, green, red)
description: Perform ascending paper chromatography to separate the components of the given ink mixture and determine their retention factors (R_f).

title: Experiment 11 — Demonstrate the Conductivity of Different Solutions
apparatus: Equipment: Beakers, wires, battery, electrodes, bulb, crocodile clips, bulb holder, stirrer · Chemicals: Distilled water, sugar, NaCl, vinegar, HCl, NaOH and CuSO₄ solution
description: Demonstrate the electrical conductivity of strong electrolytes, weak electrolytes, and non-electrolytes using an electrode-bulb circuit.

title: Experiment 12 — Demonstrate Electroplating of Copper Metal on an Iron Strip
apparatus: Equipment: Iron and copper strips, beaker, battery, wires, bulb, bulb holder, crocodile clips · Chemicals: Copper sulphate (CuSO₄) solution
description: Demonstrate the electrolytic deposition (electroplating) of copper metal onto an iron strip using a copper anode and aqueous copper(II) sulphate electrolyte.
